task_assertion: After CSV export, 12 missing Stock Price cells are imputed with the mean of 48 observed prices (39.20125), producing median 25.27 written as the only content of result.txt.

upstream_dependency_graph.description: Export the five-column stock workbook table to CSV without losing blank Stock Price cells.
Compute the Stock Price mean from the 48 observed values and identify 12 missing values.
Impute all missing values and independently compute the 60-value median.
Write only 25.27 to result.txt and run compare_result_files.
